subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the repository accept these 14 new third-party action revisions across token, scanning, release, Docker, automation, and Codex workflows after direct contract inspection and exact-head validation?
rationale: The changes are mechanically narrow, but approving new executable action revisions on secret-bearing and publishing workflows is an owner-controlled supply-chain decision that automated review cannot safely make.

options.title: Approve after full verification
options.body: Have secops and relevant workflow owners verify the pins and Codex contract, refresh the branch, and merge only after exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Split sensitive updates
options.body: Land ordinary setup-action bumps separately and review token, CodeQL, publishing, Blacksmith, and Codex pins in smaller owner-approved PRs.

options.title: Defer the grouped update
options.body: Pause or close the grouped bump if maintainers cannot complete the combined supply-chain review now.

recommendation.title: Approve after full verification
recommendation.body: Have secops and relevant workflow owners verify the pins and Codex contract, refresh the branch, and merge only after exact-head checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS explicitly assigns the security-sensitive workflow subset to this team.
